## macOS

These are the development tools and supporting utilities configured in the current macOS bundle. Exact versions depend on the bundle release you install. This is not a list of every library or internal helper used by your environment.

### Development tools

| Tool | Command | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`antigravity-cli`](<https://antigravity.google>) | `agy` | Google's Go-based terminal user interface (TUI) agent client |
| [`bat`](<https://github.com/sharkdp/bat>) | `bat` | Cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration |
| [`ccusage`](<https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage>) | `ccusage` | Analyze coding agent CLI token usage and costs from local data |
| [`claude-code`](<https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code>) | `claude` | Agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster |
| [`codex`](<https://github.com/openai/codex>) | `codex` | Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal |
| [`delta`](<https://github.com/dandavison/delta>) | `delta` | Syntax-highlighting pager for git |
| [`direnv`](<https://direnv.net>) | `direnv` | Shell extension that manages your environment |
| [`eza`](<https://github.com/eza-community/eza>) | `eza` | Modern, maintained replacement for ls |
| [`fd`](<https://github.com/sharkdp/fd>) | `fd` | Simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find |
| [`fzf`](<https://github.com/junegunn/fzf>) | `fzf` | Command-line fuzzy finder written in Go |
| [`gh`](<https://cli.github.com/>) | `gh` | GitHub CLI tool |
| [`git`](<https://git-scm.com/>) | `git` | Distributed version control system |
| [`jq`](<https://jqlang.github.io/jq/>) | `jq` | Lightweight and flexible command-line JSON processor |
| [`ripgrep`](<https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep>) | `rg` | Utility that combines the usability of The Silver Searcher with the raw speed of grep |
| [`starship`](<https://starship.rs>) | `starship` | Minimal, blazing fast, and extremely customizable prompt for any shell |
| [`uv`](<https://github.com/astral-sh/uv>) | `uv` | Extremely fast Python package installer and resolver, written in Rust |
| [`zoxide`](<https://github.com/ajeetdsouza/zoxide>) | `zoxide` | Fast cd command that learns your habits |
| [`zsh`](<https://www.zsh.org/>) | `zsh` | Z shell |

### Supporting system tools

| Tool | Command | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`bash-interactive`](<https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/>) | `bash` | GNU Bourne-Again Shell, the de facto standard shell on Linux (for interactive use) |
| [`nix`](<https://nixos.org/nix>) | `nix` | Nix package manager |
| [`texinfo-interactive`](<https://www.gnu.org/software/texinfo/>) | `texi2any` | GNU documentation system |
